positions.title: Senior Thesis
positions.description: I worked with Professor Henny Admoni to study Quori as a peer tutor in a group setting. In particular, I will be researching how to use social eye gaze and arm gestures to redirect attention effectively to create a productive peer group tutoring interaction.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I graded papers, led recitations, and held office hours for an introduction to computer systems course and an introduction to data structures in C course.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: I'm worked with postdoc Nesra Yannier to further develop Norilla: a mixed-reality system to improve children's learning in an exciting way. I'm helping to develop new learning modules for Norilla.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked with the Scenarios team to improve the action classification pipeline for street footage. In particular, I utilized a deep learning model that performed temporal action detection. I also helped prepare Lyft's dataset for its competition at the Neurips conference.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked on the query team to help full-time engineers improve features of the aggregation pipeline.

positions.title: Future Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked with the Amazon Marketplace team to develop an Alexa skill to benefit sellers.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: I worked with Dr. Borries Demeler to create a spectral analysis program and conducted different experiments with a multiwavelength spectrophotometer to test the program.

volunteerExperiences.description: I partnered up with a child with disabilities and assisted them with different summer camp activities for a couple of weeks each summer.
